items.title: The image of a closed nowhere dense subset under a quasi-finite morphism is nowhere dense

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that the image of a closed nowhere dense subset under a quasi-finite morphism is nowhere dense in the target (statement lines 15253-15258). The counted proof is a clean reduction carrying the content of the quasi-finite structure theorem: it reduces to an affine base and then to a single affine chart of the source, applies the factorization of a quasi-finite morphism as an open immersion followed by a finite morphism, observes that the closure of the image of the subset in the intermediate affine scheme is nowhere dense because the immersion is open, and concludes by the already established finite case (proof lines 15260-15284). It is H2: every reduction is carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the structure theorem and standard facts about nowhere dense sets.
